notes: Hand-curated synthetic fixture for the wireless/RAN systems engineer archetype. One ExpectedUnit per fact-bearing bullet across the EXPERIENCE + SIDE PROJECTS sections.

expected_units.normalized_summary: Designed type-II codebook beamforming pipeline for Helix 64T64R massive MIMO platform on Marvell Octeon DPU; demonstrated 14% downlink throughput improvement in 16-UE indoor cell trial
Owned MU-MIMO scheduler co-design across L1 and L2, introduced one-slot precoder-prediction filter that reduced rank mismatch events by 38% on FR1 8-layer test set

Built RAN digital twin pipeline ingesting real-world channel sounding traces from three trial sites through GPU-accelerated link-level simulator (NVIDIA Sionna plus custom CUDA channel filter), emits regression suite as L1 merge gate
Led spectrum-sharing receiver work for CBRS and C-band guard region, designed iterative SIC receiver for in-band UE-to-UE leakage; published at Globecom 2024 and shipped in 24.3 firmware

Owned L1 firmware integration for hyperscaler private-5G deployment at 1.2M-square-foot logistics facility, drove ten-week bring-up including fronthaul-clock-jitter root-cause; 99.4% uplink reliability across 14,000 handheld scanners
Authored Helix internal channel model library (TDL, CDL, 3GPP 38.901 spatial channel model in CUDA) — standard simulation backend for L1, L2, RF system teams across three product lines
Implemented LDPC decoder offload pipeline on Marlowe 5K baseband, hit 14 Gbps peak decode budget for 100 MHz NR carrier, reduced PUSCH BLER by 0.6 dB versus prior fixed-point implementation

Co-designed SRS-based channel estimation pipeline for FR2 mmWave deployments, implemented panel-aware spatial filter in fixed-point C on modem DSP; shipped in 4.2 release supporting 28 GHz and 39 GHz US carriers
Owned SSB beam management algorithm for 64T64R AAU product, designed beam-sweep schedule across SS burst sets and L1-RSRP filter; became company default beam-management config for FR1 macro cells

Drove field-trial debug for Tier-1 European operator 700 MHz refarm, root-caused PRACH false-detection regression to numerology-mismatch in cell-search engine and authored patch; carrier launched on schedule
Led cross-team response to 3GPP Release 17 spec ambiguity around CSI-RS resource mapping in CoMP, drove internal interpretation review and submitted three CRs to RAN1 of which two were accepted
Built Marlowe internal RF impairments simulation library (PA AM-AM/AM-PM, IQ imbalance, phase noise) and link-level regression harness; caught 27 BLER-class regressions over 18 months
Implemented LTE 256-QAM downlink demodulator and equalizer, passed conformance against Anritsu and Rohde & Schwarz test sets, shipped in modem reference design
Co-authored NR sub-6 prototype polar code decoder including SCL list-decoding kernel; decoder formed basis of production polar block in next-gen modem
Authored seven peer-reviewed papers in IEEE TSP, JSAC, ICASSP and built 16-antenna USRP testbed in GNU Radio that became lab standard channel-sounding platform for three years
Built OpenChannelModel — pure-Python 3GPP TR 38.901 spatial channel model with CUDA acceleration; 800+ GitHub stars, used by two academic groups and a competitor
Built two-node channel sounder for 2.4 and 5 GHz ISM bands on GNU Radio and USRP B210 SDRs; led GNU Radio Conference 2023 workshop, top search result for USRP B210 channel sounder
